events.title: Drawquarium has changed a LOT since the demo in May 🐟
events.summary: Hey everyone! 👋Back in May, I released the first demo of Drawquarium. Since then, I have been working on the game pretty much nonstop, and a lot has changed.From the beginning, my goal with Drawquarium has been to create something that helps you slow down and relax. Something you can interact with whenever you feel like it, while your aquarium continues living peacefully in the background. events.title: The Demo Is Delayed
events.summary: Hey Drawquarium Community 👋, This was actually meant to be a surprise for almost 35,000 people who have wishlisted Drawquarium. I wanted to announce the demo today, on Friday, April 17, and simply share the good news with all of you. But sadly, things did not go as planned. My demo submission did not go through because one required image was missing, and right now I am still waiting to hear back from Valve support.
